title: Service-level authentication and authorization procedure accepted by the UE

entities.name: Service-level authentication and authorization procedure
entities.description: Procedure for service-level authentication and authorization initiated by the DN and accepted by the UE.

entities.name: SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE
entities.description: NAS message created by the UE to complete service-level authentication and authorization.

entities.name: Service-level-AA container
entities.description: Information element containing the service-level-AA payload.

entities.name: service-level-AA payload
entities.description: Payload provided by upper layers for service-level authentication and authorization.

entities.name: NAS transport procedure
entities.description: Procedure used to transport NAS messages including SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE.

entities.name: PDU session ID
entities.description: Identifier for the PDU session associated with the service-level authentication.

entities.name: T3594
entities.description: Timer stopped by SMF upon receipt of SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message.

entities.name: SMF
entities.description: Session Management Function that processes SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message.

entities.name: DN
entities.description: Data Network that initiates service-level authentication and receives the payload.

relations.description: Service-level authentication procedure includes creating SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message.
SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message contains Service-level-AA container IE.
Service-level-AA container IE contains the service-level-AA payload.
SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message is transported using NAS transport procedure.
SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message is transported with PDU session ID.
SMF stops timer T3594 upon receipt of SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message.
SMF provides service-level-AA payload to DN after receiving SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message.
